Door sensor: contact debounce, save queue, TX, ACK. persistent_queue false means queue in volatile RAM; but throughout operation with power maybe enough. Cold-contact challenge maybe long idle with leakage? esr 5, capacitance 100uF. Long idle 50k seconds might drain? Brownout resets? If voltage falls below brownout while idle, RAM cleared. But supply capacitor with leakage 100M and idle 2uA, 100uF, 5 ohm, will discharge? At idle, no energy source; leakage only? Components: idle_a 2uA continuous, leakage 100M across cap. Cap 100uF. Time constant RC = 100e6*100e-6=10000 s. 0.5V drop from 2.2 to 1.8 is 0.4V; t = -RC ln(1 - .4/2.2)= ~2000 s. So after ~2k s brownout resets. In first continuous cycles at 61-74 likely no issue. In third with cycle at 43019s, device resets long before. But if persistent_queue true, event ids retained but seq? At reset, queue retained, last committed. If no events before long idle, reset seq to 0, okay. But no absolute clock, event sequence only. For task with cold first two cycles close then third at 51017, device brownout resets between, with persistent false loses committed seq and last_direction; after reset seq=0, gateway expects sequence continuous maybe event order require? Need persistent_queue true to persist sequence across brownouts. Could also increase capacitance to avoid brownout over 50k seconds, impossible max 0.001F =1000uF => RC=100k s, drop 0.5V? t=~23k s maybe still not 51k. Need maybe 1000uF and low esr? Leakage fixed 100M, idle 2uA. With 1000uF RC=100000 s; drop after 50k: V=2.2e^{-0.5}=1.33 <1.8. Actually more complex. Max 1000uF, 50k s drop: Q=2uA*50k=0.1C; ΔV=100V! Wait idle 2uA into 1mF: 0.1V per 50s? 2uA*50,000=0.1C, C=0.001F => 100V. But leakage 100M provides 20nA at 2V, not enough. So cap drains quickly. Actually 100uF: 2uA for 10s =20uC => 0.2V; so very quick. Wait idle current 2uA continuous (microcontroller idle). Brownout after ~10s for 100uF (from 2.2 to1.8 ΔQ=40uC, t=20s). RC due leakage 10ks but idle dominates. For max 1mF: ΔQ=400uC, t=200s. Still far short 51k. So must rely persistent queue true or startup? Brownout resets and reboots, then idle.
